# The Python packages the site build installs, at exact versions; Dependabot
# keeps them current (.github/dependabot.yml). The packages these bring in
# follow the 7-day rule in .github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml.

# Render the CV from cv.yaml. RenderCV 2.9 isn't released yet, so it comes from
# one commit of its unreleased code (rendercv/rendercv pull request 812), with
# the font package 2.9 needs, which is in the same commit. The daily run's
# check-rendercv job opens an issue once 2.9 is out; then this goes back to
# rendercv[full]==2.9, without the second line
rendercv[full] @ git+https://github.com/rendercv/rendercv@d537e0afd2c97ee1e1cc63d63491d6ffa98377b3
rendercv-fonts @ git+https://github.com/rendercv/rendercv@d537e0afd2c97ee1e1cc63d63491d6ffa98377b3#subdirectory=packages/rendercv-fonts
